name: browser-extensions
description: A monorepo of cross-browser extensions and their documentation site, built with WXT, Blume, TypeScript, and Bun.
author: My Name is Tito <github@mynameistito.com>

scripts.prepare:wxt: bun run --filter hide-email-ext postinstall && bun run --filter quote-viewer postinstall && bun run --filter new-tab-ext postinstall && bun run --filter hide-ip-ext postinstall && bun run --filter ig-video-controls postinstall && bun run --filter better-history postinstall && bun run --filter github-settings-repo-copy postinstall && bun run --filter mute-tab-manager postinstall && bun run --filter x-copy-cleaner postinstall
scripts.release:all: bun run --filter hide-email-ext ci:release && bun run --filter quote-viewer ci:release && bun run --filter new-tab-ext ci:release && bun run --filter hide-ip-ext ci:release && bun run --filter ig-video-controls ci:release && bun run --filter better-history ci:release && bun run --filter github-settings-repo-copy ci:release && bun run --filter mute-tab-manager ci:release && bun run --filter x-copy-cleaner ci:release
scripts.version: changeset version && bun run --filter quote-viewer linkify-changelog && bun run --filter ig-video-controls linkify-changelog
